text: にじいろに　うすく　かがやく。

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く makes it tell how an action is done. うすく　かがやく = 'glows faintly'.

patterns.name: 〜に (how)
patterns.explanation: に after a color word tells in what color something shines or is dyed. にじいろに = 'in rainbow colors'.
